scope: Accuracy accounting implementation; no engineering decisions authored by this audit

metric.numerator: Confirmed original AI proposals under the configured reviewer authority
metric.denominator: Confirmed plus rejected original AI proposals in the current reviewed sample
metric.empty_sample: accuracy is null, reviewed is zero
metric.deduplication: Latest eligible outcome per original target on current evidence
metric.authority: Direct configured reviewer or delegated_by matching the configured reviewer; actual executor remains in immutable receipts
metric.mapping_outcomes: An accepted original relationship confirms the proposal. An accepted differing relationship or an explicitly rejected mapping rejects the original proposal. The replacement is not a new correct AI sample.
metric.replacement_outcomes: Accepted corrections, set values, option selections and manual links are not accuracy outcomes. An earlier positive outcome is superseded; an earlier explicit rejection remains measured. Later outcomes for the human replacement are excluded.
metric.source_binding: Only nonempty current source fingerprints score. Source-obsolete and unbound receipts are excluded.
metric.prediction_binding: Optional prediction_sha256 binds state/value/options/selected/type to the original AI interpretation. Reader/review/correction/name metadata is excluded; embedded geometry and omission reasons remain bound.
metric.mapping_prior_proposals: Compatible prior-proposal approvals can remain effective in the application but do not score a refreshed proposal because the legacy prior receipt does not retain its original relationship.
metric.prep_metrics: Prep-model verification remains separate and unchanged under prep

disclosures.delegated_reviewed: Authorized delegated outcomes included in the current reviewed sample
disclosures.legacy_prediction_unbound_reviewed: Source-bound legacy field outcomes without a prediction hash; this limitation is explicit
disclosures.excluded_decisions: Receipt counts by exclusion reason, not unique proposal counts
limitations: Reviewed-sample agreement is not whole-dataset accuracy.
Review outcomes do not imply whole-design approval.
A legacy field receipt without prediction_sha256 cannot independently establish whether an interpretation changed on the same unchanged source.
This audit does not assign accuracy scores to unsupported-template dispositions, newly supplied geometry or parser-formatting assistance.

verification.local_test_execution: Not run; full execution is reserved for GitHub-hosted Actions under workspace instructions
coverage: Configured authority, unauthorized actor exclusion and delegated outcome count
Latest outcome deduplication and current-source binding
Immutable mapping proposal agreement, changed relationship and explicit rejection
Prior mapping receipts with unavailable original relationship
Human replacement barriers and preserved explicit original rejection
Prediction changes on an unchanged PDF
Store.append binds the original extraction rather than a replayed replacement
Changed interpretation reopens review while reader-only refresh preserves it
Geometry and omission-reason changes affect prediction hashes

live_reviewed_sample_note: Coordinator records the final live sample only after new authorized decisions and remote verification. No score is invented by this audit.
